reference_rights: Source media retain their own rights and credits. Narrow authenticated private research handling was reviewed separately. This does not establish an open source-media license, photographer permission, ownership of architecture, public-model legal clearance or endorsement.
temporal_limit: Target is a bounded approximate historical exterior associated with sources published in 2017–2022. Capture dates are not proven. PTS published 2017-09-18 and modified 2025-08-13; image addition dates unknown. Portal photograph date unknown. Not a completed-2026-repair as-built.
mandatory_same_end_correction: F02 and F04 show the SAME short end; the other end is grounded in P01 page 8 attachment 5 and G04, corroborated by A01.
palette: Hand-authored uncalibrated colors. No automatic source sampling or photographic textures.
